headline: Media, gaming, publishing and education firms show mixed performance while expanding AI and quantum tech investments.
summary: Revenue growth is strong at Disney and Bally's, but Caesars posted a widened loss. Pearson accelerated revenue and cut guidance, whereas Scholastic missed its target. Companies across sectors are increasing AI spend, with notable quantum funding at NYU. Cost‑cutting and tighter IT budgets appear at WBD.

industries.summary: Disney posted 7% revenue growth and strong operating margin. WBD raised its EBITDA outlook but is tightening IT spend. Versant remains stable with digital focus. Overall sentiment is upbeat despite mixed IT outlooks.

leaders.why: Revenue up 7% and multiple AI patents

laggards.why: Tightening IT spend and cost‑cutting program

themes.title: AI & tech investment
themes.detail: Disney is buying AI tech and filing patents; WBD is integrating AI news licensing.

themes.title: Cost management
themes.detail: WBD launched a voluntary buyout to save $6bn.

industries.it_note: Disney expands AI spend, WBD tightens, Versant stays stable; account teams should balance growth opportunities with cost constraints.

industries.summary: Bally's delivered 20% revenue growth, while Caesars posted a $123 M loss. Light & Wonder and Brightstar showed neutral results. Tech spending is expanding at Bally's and Brightstar, with cashless payment rollouts.

leaders.why: 20% revenue growth driven by B2C and interactive platforms

themes.title: Cashless payment rollout
themes.detail: Light & Wonder launched RAPIDPLAY cashless systems at multiple casinos.

themes.title: IT expansion
themes.detail: Bally's and Brightstar are expanding technology infrastructure and contracts.

industries.it_note: Bally's expanding spend, Caesars unclear; focus on supporting cashless initiatives and monitoring cost pressures.

industries.summary: Pearson accelerated revenue and cut profit guidance, Wolters Kluwer is expanding AI tools, while Scholastic missed revenue targets. AI partnerships are common, and Pearson pursued acquisitions to boost assessment tech.

themes.title: AI integration
themes.detail: Wolters Kluwer launched AI tax and legal tools; Pearson added AI‑driven assessment platforms.

themes.title: M&A activity
themes.detail: Pearson acquired ITS and Workera; Scholastic is buying Cottage Door Press.

industries.it_note: Both Wolters and Pearson are increasing AI spend; account teams should highlight AI solution fit and monitor Scholastic's cost pressures.

industries.summary: Pearson continues growth, NYU secured $284 M for a quantum fabrication facility, and SLU expanded AI collaboration with WWT. ACT provides no new signals. Technology spend is broadly expanding.

leaders.why: Major city‑backed funding for quantum fabrication

themes.title: Quantum technology funding
themes.detail: NYU receives up to $284 M partnership to build a quantum fab facility.

themes.title: AI collaborations
themes.detail: WWT partners with SLU for AI research and branding.

industries.it_note: Strong quantum and AI investments suggest opportunities for advanced computing and data platforms.
